verdict.rationale: Dynadot's built-in AI feature is AI Domain Search, which generates name and TLD suggestions but does not take delegated tasks. Task delegation to an AI assistant, such as checking availability, registering domains, and reviewing DNS, is offered only through its MCP server, which you connect to an external assistant rather than one inside the product. Missing for 10: an in-product AI assistant that accepts delegated tasks, documentation of in-app agent workflows, and hands-on corroboration.
